packageRules.description: One weekly PR for all non-major updates; majors stay in their own PRs.
Postgres majors need a dump and restore: open the PR as a warning, never merge it as is.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Postgres major version: do not merge as is.** The data directory of a major version cannot be read by the next one. Plan a dump and restore (or `pg_upgrade`) first.
